name: Electric guitar strings
definition: string set or single string made for an electric guitar; gauge and winding are attributes.
notes: Shops list Electric Guitar Strings as their own category.

name: Acoustic guitar strings
definition: steel string set or single string made for a steel-string acoustic guitar.
notes: Shops list Acoustic Guitar Strings as their own category.

name: Classical guitar strings
definition: nylon or gut string set or single string made for a classical guitar.
notes: Shops list Classical Guitar Strings as their own category.

name: Bass guitar strings
definition: string set or single string made for a bass guitar, sold by string count and scale.
notes: Shops list Bass Guitar Strings as their own category.

name: Diatonic harmonica
definition: harmonica with one scale per key, ten holes in Richter tuning, played without a slide.

name: Chromatic harmonica
definition: harmonica with a slide lever that gives all twelve semitones.

name: Piano accordion
definition: accordion with a piano-style keyboard for the right hand and bass buttons for the left.

name: Button accordion
definition: accordion with buttons for the right hand, chromatic or diatonic, and bass buttons for the left.
